message: 秘密のさぷらいず

name: Synn
message: 「Today's special is...」

name: Paqy
message: 「I wanna eat some meat」

name: Synn
message: 「If they have beef jerky on sale, sure」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's not a real dish!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Thank you so much for accommodating our unreasonable request today」

name: Everyone
message: 「Thank you very much」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh?」
It's Nanaka, Sacchin, Okamoto-san, and Fuyuka-san.

name: Fuyuka
message: 「It is nothing worthy of such thanks」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, I'm sorry for troubling you during business hours」

name: Synn
message: 「I wonder what they're doing at Chocolat's back door?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Bet that spacey little missy got caught sneaking food」

name: Synn
message: 「Definitely not」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Nanaka-san, you wanted to see them at work above all else, did you not?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even so... to actually let us see a busy kitchen in action. No amount of thanks could ever be enough」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「As I said, there is no need for thanks. However, if you still feel indebted, please show your gratitude through everyone's hard work」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yes!」

name: Synn
message: 「Looks like it was a kitchen tour」

name: Paqy
message: 「Even though she can't even cook. Talk about casting pearls before swine」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Nanaka-san. Let us go on a food tour once the Holy Night Festival is over. Next time, perhaps to Paris together」

name: Nanaka
message: 「P-Paris!?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I'm all for it! Having a rich friend is the best!」

name: Yumil
message: 「My stomach's growling」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「By all means, please do. When the time comes, bring your friends along as well」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yay!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Learn some restraint, you guys!」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Fufufu. Well then, see you later」

name: Yumil
message: 「No matter when you see her, she's always so brisk and cool. No muscles, though」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Even so, Nana-chan, your goals are way too high. There's always someone lower down, you know」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What good is looking down!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Maybe there's money dropped on the ground」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey there, Nanaka. Sacchin. Okamoto-san」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Gah!? W-Why are you here!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Shopping. What about you guys?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Hellooo. It's Perv-Synn」

name: Synn
message: 「H-How cruel!」

name: Yumil
message: 「So Senpai's a guy after all. Nuhaha. No trapezius muscles, though」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hell yeah! A man's all about what's below the belt!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Coming from a plushie, that doesn't mean much」

name: Paqy
message: 「I sure miss the flesh-and-blood body I threw away」

name: Synn
message: 「Sweets Club activities?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「U-Um, well, something like that」

name: Sacchin
message: 「We paid a visit to the kitchen. I scored a huge victory」

name: Synn
message: 「Over what?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I won the Armageddon against the temptation to sneak a bite」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't brag about something like that!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「And then, mmph, mmph」

name: Yumil
message: 「You can't say that」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That'll ruin the surprise!」

name: Synn
message: 「Surprise?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What are you talking about? W-Well, have fun shopping! Bye!」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you think the surprise is?」

name: Paqy
message: 「When a washed-up idol talks about a surprise, it means stripping naked for a photobook and DVD」

name: Synn
message: 「Trans-form! Shwah!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kinda weird vibes, but it's looking good」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. I feel like I'm getting the hang of it.」
Ever since coming home today, I've been practicing being a Demon Lord.

name: Paqy
message: 「Going smoothly」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's call it a day here and get to sleep early for once--」

name: Sally
message: 「Prez, you're being a delinquent again!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahaha! I'm a delinquent! A brand-new, shiny first-year delinquent!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Way too wholesome for a delinquent」

name: Sally
message: 「Do you really wanna be a delinquent that bad?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, it's not like th--」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hell yeah! Lord Synn is the delinquent of delinquents! He's got a massive dream of becoming the strongest delinquent in this world!」

name: Sally
message: 「Awesome! I get it, you're Bancho Sarayashiki!」

name: Synn
message: 「What's that?」

name: Sally
message: 「You're a delinquent and you don't even know?! I'll tell ya!」

name: Sally
message: 「He's an amazing boss! Apparently, just by him counting plates, everyone around him trembles in fear!」

name: Sally
message: 「At least, that's what Roro-chi said!」

name: Paqy
message: 「What's wrong, Lord Synn? If you look sleepy tomorrow, your reputation as a pervert will finally be set in stone」

name: Synn
message: 「That's why I went to bed early, isn't it」
I don't want Nanaka thinking of me like that.

name: Paqy
message: 「Doesn't mean anything if you can't fall asleep」

name: Synn
message: 「What could the surprise be?」

name: Paqy
message: 「A surprise from a washed-up idol--」

name: Synn
message: 「Do you think she's planning to do something at the Holy Night Festival?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, probably. Considering the date. You'll find out whether you like it or not when the day comes」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, that's true, I guess」

name: Paqy
message: 「Either that, or she's got some guy she's secretly dating」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaaaaaat!? R-Really!? No way!?」
I hadn't even thought of that, but it makes sense. Nanaka's at that age, after all.
Still, why without telling me anything?
I'm just her childhood friend, after all. There was never any reason she had to tell me in the first place.

name: Paqy
message: 「Like hell that's the case. That Soba hooking up with someone, yeah right」

name: Synn
message: 「...R-Right. Yeah, you're right」
If she actually had someone like that, it would've turned into a much bigger fuss when she kissed me.
Nanaka isn't the type to let just anyone kiss her lightly, after all.

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, it's probably no big secret. Compared to what you're carrying around, Lord Synn」

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe so, but...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Something like that is keeping you awake?」

name: Synn
message: 「...Hey, Paqy」

name: Paqy
message: 「Huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「Among all the Demon Lords up until now, has anyone ever confessed to the people around them that they were the Demon Lord?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Some got found out, some spilled it themselves--there were all kinds」

name: Synn
message: 「I see...」

name: Paqy
message: 「And the reactions of the people they told were all over the place, too」

name: Synn
message: 「Like what?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Some of 'em didn't believe it at all, while others knelt down hoping to get a scrap of power. There were even guys driven by some bizarre sense of duty who came attacking」
If it's Nanaka... I feel like she'd be okay.
Still, she was scared of the Demon Lord...
I really can't tell her.

name: Paqy
message: 「Still, y'know. Even if you weren't the Demon Lord, everybody's got secrets」

name: Synn
message: 「That might be true, but...」

name: Synn
message: 「No, wait--before I became the Demon Lord, I didn't have a single secret from Nanaka」

name: Synn
message: 「I bet Nanaka still doesn't keep any secrets from me even now...」

name: Paqy
message: 「There's that Holy Night Festival surprise」

name: Synn
message: 「Not that kind of thing... I mean a secret that might change our relationship if it gets out」

name: Paqy
message: 「You hate keeping things from Soba?」

name: Synn
message: 「...I'm just not used to keeping secrets」

name: Paqy
message: 「Listen, Lord Synn. That's just what you think」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Paqy
message: 「By the way, the secret yours truly is dying to know is Ria-chan's exact bust size!」
